name: context-handoff
description: Detect context compaction and transfer long-running Codex work into a fresh verified thread without losing acceptance criteria or evidence.

interface.longDescription: Detect context pressure with throttled local lifecycle checks, then safely continue work in a fresh verified thread. Preserve language, Goal state, scoped authorization, runtime permission checks and evidence. Verify destination visibility and opening without pinning before authorized source archival. Record exact-session token usage without assuming savings.
defaultPrompt: Checkpoint this task and continue it in a fresh verified thread.
Prepare a safe handoff packet for this long-running Codex task.
Check context health and hand off only if a fresh thread is warranted.
